thread.title: Cyber security stocks fall as investors shrug off China spy threat - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Cyber security stocks fall as investors shrug off China spy threat - MarketWatch
text: Shares of cyber security companies were mostly lower Thursday, along with the broader stock market , as investors shrugged off a report that Chinese operatives inserted microchips in motherboards sold to Apple Inc. AAPL, -1.76% and Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, -2.17% The ETFMG Prime Cyber Security ETF HACK, -1.97% shed 0.9% in morning trade, with 43 of its 52 equity components losing ground, while the First Trust Nasdaq Cybersecurity ETF CIBR, -1.80% slid 1.0%, with 33 of 38 components declining. The biggest winner in both ETFs was FireEye Inc.'s stock FEYE, +2.30% which surged 4.6%. Among others, shares of Okta Inc. OKTA, -4.67% lost 2.7%, Palo Alto Networks Inc. PANW, -0.88% tacked on 0.3%, Symantec Corp. SYMC, -1.30% slipped 0.5%, BlackBerry Ltd. BB, -2.84% lost 1.8%, SailPoint Technologies Holdings Inc. SAIL, -6.16% dropped 4.6% and Zscaler Inc. ZS, -1.05% declined 1.8%. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq Composite COMP, -1.81% fell 1.5% and the S&P 500 SPX, -0.82% lost 0.8%.
